question: An engineer must replace a defective fabric interconnect with the same model. The system must be restored, including the database of locally created users. The equivalent Cisco UCS Manager software version must be used. Which backup type must be used to meet these requirements?
theory: Replacing a defective fabric interconnect and restoring it — including the locally created user database — while requiring the exact same UCS Manager software version, is precisely the use case a Full State backup is designed for: it's a complete binary snapshot of the whole system's configuration and runtime state (including local user accounts), restorable only to a fabric interconnect running the same software version it was taken from. The XML-based All/System/Logical Configuration backups don't restore local user databases or provide a ground-up system rebuild the way Full State does. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Configuration Management, Full State Backup and Restore)
